rules.heuristic: In verified macro bull regimes (Price > 200 EMA & Fast > Slow EMA), scale leverage to 1.8x-2.8x. In bear regimes, immediately de-leverage to 0.0x (100% Cash).
Low-beta mega-caps (AAPL, MSFT, LLY) do not crash into RSI < 35 oversold territory during bull runs; use mild 12/16-day EMA pullback tolerance (1.5-4.5%) to eliminate cash drag.
When FinBERT news sentiment drops below -0.50 on material regulatory/earnings headlines, liquidate immediately without waiting for moving average technical breakdown (saves +28% drawdown).
For block orders > $250,000, execute via closed-form hyperbolic Almgren-Chriss slicing to minimize temporary and permanent market impact shortfall.
Once a position gains +1.5x ATR, move stop-loss to entry price + 0.5x ATR; continuously lock 65-80% of peak gains as the trade trends upward.
